text: dsh-diagram-design 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的图表工具插件，注册导入、导出、校验和环境诊断工具，并在侧栏提供 45 种图表示例画廊。它可将 draw.io、Mermaid 或 Excalidraw 文件解析为结构摘要，将 HTML 图表导出为 SVG 或 PNG，并检查生成的图表文件。适合需要在 DSH 工作流中整理图表结构、查看样例或导出图表文件的用户。无需 API 密钥；运行工具需要 python3，PNG 导出需自行准备 Playwright 和 Chromium。

dsh-diagram-design adds diagram tools and a 45-type example gallery to DSH Web. It imports draw.io, Mermaid, and Excalidraw into structural summaries, exports HTML diagrams to SVG or PNG, and checks diagram files. PNG export needs Playwright and Chromium; tools need python3.
我想把 Mermaid 图解析成节点和连线摘要，方便重新绘制。
能把生成的图表 HTML 文件导出成 SVG 或 PNG 吗？
I need to browse diagram examples and preview different chart types in DSH.
dsh-diagram-design 的功能「图表格式转换」：通过 diagram_export 工具把 HTML 图表导出为 SVG、PNG 或两种格式，并可指定输出路径；PNG 导出需要 Playwright。
dsh-diagram-design 的功能「图表来源解析与画廊预览」：diagram_extract 将 draw.io、Mermaid 或 Excalidraw 文件解析为结构摘要；侧栏画廊可搜索图表类型并查看对应的 HTML 示例。
dsh-diagram-design 使用前须知：SVG 导出脚本包含 Google Fonts 样式表引用，可能向 fonts.googleapis.com 发起网络请求；导出参数可选择 system_fonts 跳过该引用。

dsh-diagram-design README · dsh-diagram-design：Diagram Design tools and gallery for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): export HTML diagrams to SVG/PNG, import from draw.io / Mermaid / Excalidraw, validate output, and browse a gallery of 45 diagram types.

dsh-diagram-design README · What it does：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `diagram_export` | Export a diagram-design HTML file to a standalone SVG and/or PNG. |
| `diagram_extract` | Parse a draw.io / Mermaid / Excalidraw file into a normalized digest for redrawing. |
| `diagram_self_check` | Validate a generated diagram HTML file (accessible-SVG, single-file safety, viewBox). |
| `diagram_doctor` | Diagnose the environment: bundled scripts, python3, Playwright availability. |

dsh-diagram-design README · What it does：The gallery panel (sidebar "Diagram Gallery") lists the 45 diagram types with
live example previews.

dsh-diagram-design README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin add github:Shang-ZZ/dsh-diagram-design
```

PNG export is the only feature that needs an extra dependency, installed once
on demand (never automatically):

```bash
pip install playwright && playwright install chromium
```
